title: Data Table
description: The table with its working clothes on: sortable columns, selectable rows, and an honest footer.
a11y: The table has a caption. Native header buttons sort text/numeric columns; aria-sort is on their column headers. Named row/select-all checkboxes retain selection through sorting. Mixed selection sets the select-all indeterminate state. A polite status reports sorting and selection counts. Each table keeps its own state.
